name: InkRoom Prompts
tagline: Free image-prompt search with paired examples and text optimization, without an API key.
description: Search public image prompts with their paired original library examples, or improve an idea into an image prompt. Free service subject to shared limits; no login, API key or MCP Token. Does not generate images or use paid InkRoom image credits. Requires Node.js 20.3+. The dedicated service is https://prompts.inkroom.ai; this is separate from paid inkroom.

install.notes: Free prompt search and text optimization only. No public Remote MCP endpoint or npm-registry publication is claimed. Version 0.1.0-preview.3 is distributed by GitHub Releases.
